scenario: Subject + have + some + plural countable noun (Olumlu cümlede some)
grammar: I have some apples in my bag.
en: I have some apples in my bag.
ipa: /aɪ hæv sʌm ˈæpəlz ɪn maɪ bæg/
trPron: Ay hev sam epılz in may bag
collocations: have some apples, some apples in
commonMistake: I have any apples in my bag. ❌
aiExplain: Olumlu cümlelerde sayılabilir çoğul isimlerle "some" kullanılır. "Any" olumluda yanlıştır.

scenario: Subject + have + some + uncountable noun (Olumlu cümlede some)
en: I need some water.
trPron: Ay nid sam vatır
collocations: need some water, some water
commonMistake: I need any water. ❌
aiExplain: Olumlu cümlelerde sayılamayan isimlerle de "some" kullanılır.

scenario: Do/Does + subject + have + any + plural countable noun?
en: Do you have any questions?
trPron: Du yu hev eni kuesçınz
collocations: do you have any, any questions
commonMistake: Do you have some questions? ✔️ (olumlu cevap bekleniyorsa)
aiExplain: Soru cümlelerinde genellikle "any" kullanılır. "Some" da kullanılabilir (olumlu cevap beklentisiyle).

scenario: Is/Are there + any + uncountable noun?
en: Is there any milk in the fridge?
ipa: /ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni mɪlk ɪn ðə frɪʤ/
trPron: İz der eni milk in dı fric
collocations: is there any, any milk in
commonMistake: Is there some milk in the fridge? ✔️
aiExplain: Soru cümlelerinde "any" sayılamayan isimlerle de kullanılır.

scenario: Subject + don't/doesn't + have + any + plural countable noun
en: I don't have any apples.
trPron: Ay dont hev eni epılz
collocations: don't have any, any apples
commonMistake: I don't have some apples. ❌
aiExplain: Olumsuz cümlelerde "any" kullanılır. "Some" olumsuzda yanlıştır.

scenario: Subject + don't/doesn't + have + any + uncountable noun
en: There isn't any milk left.
trPron: Der izınt eni milk left
collocations: isn't any milk, any milk left
commonMistake: There isn't some milk left. ❌
aiExplain: InformativeOlumsuz cümlelerde "any" sayılamayan isimlerle de kullanılır.

scenario: Subject + never + verb + any + noun (Hiç ... asla)
en: some, a little
trPron: A1
collocations: any, never, strong-negative
commonMistake: Informa

scenario: Subject + hardly + verb + any + noun (Neredeyse hiç)
en: There is hardly any sugar left.
trPron: Der iz hardli eni şugır left
collocations: is hardly any, hardly any sugar
commonMistake: There is hardly some sugar left. ❌
aiExplain: Descriptive"Hardly" (neredeyse hiç) ile birlikte "any" kullanılır.

topic: Some in offers (Would you like some?)
scenario: Would you like + some + noun? (Teklif cümlelerinde some)
en: Would you like some coffee?
trPron: Vud yu layk sam kofi
collocations: would you like some, some coffee
commonMistake: Would you like any coffee? ✔️ (doğru da)
aiExplain: Teklif cümlelerinde (Would you like...?) olumlu beklenti olduğu için "some" kullanılır.

topic: Some in requests (Can I have some?)
scenario: Can I have + some + noun? (Rica cümlelerinde some)
en: Can I have some sugar, please?
trPron: Ken ay hev sam şugır pliz
collocations: can I have some, some sugar
commonMistake: Can I have any sugar? ✔️ (doğru da)
aiExplain: PoliteRica cümlelerinde (Can I have...?) olumlu beklenti olduğu için "some" kullanılır.

scenario: If + subject + want/need + some + noun (If ile some mümkün)
en: If you need some help, let me know.
tr: Biraz yardıma ihtiyacın olursa, bana haber ver.
ipa: /ɪf juː nid sʌm hɛlp lɛt mi noʊ/
trPron: İf yu nid sam help let mi no
collocations: if you need some, some help
commonMistake: If you need any help, let me know. ✔️
aiExplain: Helpful"If" cümleciğinde "some" kullanılabilir (belirli bir miktar olduğunda).

topic: Some in positive (singular countable with unknown quantity)
scenario: Subject + has + some + singular countable noun (Bazı - tekil sayılabilir)
grammar: Some person called for you. (unknown person)
en: Some person called for you. (unknown person)
tr: Seni arayan biri vardı. (kim olduğu bilinmeyen)
trPron: Sam pörsın kol for yu
collocations: some person called, called for you
commonMistake: Any person called for you. ❌
aiExplain: Informative"Some" tekil sayılabilir isimle "belirli olmayan bir kişi/şey" anlamında kullanılabilir.

scenario: Some + plural noun meaning "certain" (bazı insanlar)
en: Some people don't like coffee.
trPron: Sam pipıl dont layk kofi
collocations: some people don't, don't like coffee
commonMistake: Any people don't like coffee. ❌
aiExplain: Informative"Some" (bazı) anlamında olumlu cümlelerde kullanılır.

scenario: Any + singular countable noun (herhangi bir)
en: You can take any book you like.
ipa: /juː kæn teɪk ˈɛni bʊk juː laɪk/
trPron: Yu ken teyk eni buk yu layk
collocations: can take any, any book you
commonMistake: You can take some book you like. ❌ (belirli bir kitap)
aiExplain: Generous"Any" (herhangi bir) anlamında tekil sayılabilir isimlerle kullanılır.

scenario: Not + any (hiç) - emphatic
en: I don't have any money at all.
ipa: /aɪ doʊnt hæv ˈɛni ˈmʌni æt ɔl/
trPron: Ay dont hev eni mani et ol
collocations: don't have any, any money at all
commonMistake: I have no money at all. ✔️
aiExplain: Emphatic"Not any" hiç anlamında vurgulu olumsuzluk ifade eder. "No" da kullanılabilir.

topic: Short answer with any (No, I don't have any)
scenario: No + subject + don't/doesn't + have + any (Kısa cevapta any)
en: Do you have any apples? - No, I don't have any.
tr: Elman var mı? - Hayır, hiç yok.
ipa: /duː juː hæv ˈɛni ˈæpəlz - noʊ aɪ doʊnt hæv ˈɛni/
trPron: Du yu hev eni epılz - no ay dont hev eni
collocations: don't have any, have any
commonMistake: No, I don't have any apples. ✔️
aiExplain: NegativeKısa cevapta "any" nesne olarak kullanılabilir.

topic: Short answer with some (Yes, I have some)
scenario: Yes + subject + have + some (Kısa cevapta some)
en: Do you have any apples? - Yes, I have some.
tr: Elman var mı? - Evet, biraz var.
ipa: /duː juː hæv ˈɛni ˈæpəlz - jɛs aɪ hæv sʌm/
trPron: Du yu hev eni epılz - yes ay hev sam
collocations: have some, I have some
commonMistake: Yes, I have. ✔️
aiExplain: AffirmativeKısa cevapta "some" nesne olarak kullanılabilir.

scenario: Let's + verb + some + noun (Öneri cümlelerinde some)
en: Let's buy some snacks for the party.
ipa: /lɛts baɪ sʌm snæks fɔr ðə ˈpɑrti/
trPron: Lets bay sam sneks for dı parti
collocations: Present Simple
commonMistake: Let's buy any snacks. ❌
aiExplain: FriendlyÖneri cümlelerinde (Let's...) olumlu beklenti olduğu için "some" kullanılır.

scenario: If + subject + need + any + noun (If ile any - daha yaygın)
en: If you need any help, call me.
tr: Herhangi bir yardıma ihtiyacın olursa, beni ara.
ipa: /ɪf juː nid ˈɛni hɛlp kɔl mi/
trPron: İf yu nid eni help kol mi
collocations: if you need any, any help
commonMistake: If you need some help, call me. ✔️
aiExplain: Helpful"If" cümleciğinde "any" daha yaygındır (belirsiz miktar).

scenario: Any + singular noun (herhangi biri)
en: Any student can answer this question.
tr: Herhangi bir öğrenci bu soruyu cevaplayabilir.
trPron: Eni studınt ken ansır dis kuesçın
collocations: any student can, can answer
commonMistake: Some student can answer this question. ❌ (belirli bir öğrenci)
aiExplain: bazı, belirli
grammarTags: A1, A1, A1, Neutral, Informative"Any" (herhangi bir) anlamında tekil sayılabilir isimle genelleme yapar., students in classroom, classroom sound, any, singular, generalization

topic: Some with "would like" (I would like some)
scenario: I would like + some + noun (Istek cümlelerinde some)
en: I would like some tea, please.
trPron: Ay vud layk sam ti pliz
collocations: would like some, some tea
commonMistake: I would like any tea. ❌ (anlam farklı)
aiExplain: Polite"I would like" ile yapılan istek cümlelerinde "some" kullanılır.

topic: Any in questions with "why" (Why don't you get any?)
scenario: Why + don't/doesn't + subject + get + any + noun?
en: Why don't you get any exercise?
trPron: Vay dont yu get eni eksırsayz
collocations: why don't you get, get any exercise
commonMistake: Why don't you get some exercise? ✔️
aiExplain: Suggestive"Why don't you...?" öneri cümlelerinde "some" daha yaygın, "any" de kullanılabilir.

scenario: Some = a few (birkaç) with countable nouns
en: I have some friends coming over.
trPron: Ay hev sam frendz kamİng ovır
collocations: have some friends, some friends coming
commonMistake: I have any friends coming over. ❌
aiExplain: Friendly"Some" sayılabilir çoğul isimlerle "birkaç" anlamında kullanılır.

scenario: Some = a little (biraz) with uncountable nouns
en: Add some salt to the soup.
trPron: Ad sam solt tu dı sup
collocations: Present Simple
commonMistake: Add any salt to the soup. ❌ (farklı anlam)
aiExplain: Instructional"Some" sayılamayan isimlerle "biraz" anlamında kullanılır.

scenario: Any + singular noun (no matter which)
en: Any day of the week is fine.
ipa: /ˈɛni deɪ əv ðə wik ɪz faɪn/
trPron: Eni dey ov dı vik iz fayn
collocations: any day of, is fine
commonMistake: Some day of the week is fine. ❌ (belirli bir gün)
aiExplain: Flexible"Any" (herhangi) anlamında seçenekler arasında fark olmadığını belirtir.
